factProposals.value: The monitor checks the Command Center site itself; CRIS is not reachable from this build, so it is not monitored yet.
Monitoring produces availability and response-time samples, incidents and alerts.

decisions.statement: Every check has a 5 second time limit and one retry, and a failure is a recorded result rather than an error.
decisions.rationale: The build rules require explicit timeouts and capped retries on every external call.

decisions.statement: One open incident per component: repeated failures do not open more.
decisions.rationale: Running a check twice must not double-create.

limitations.statement: Checks run while the page is open (on demand or every minute); there is no unattended scheduler yet, and the targets are the site's own files.
